notes.title: SP:WS v1.01 Update
notes.content:
Senpai Puzzle: Waifu Summer v1.01 is live now!

Features & improvements include:

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Waifu Quality[/b] - Your 4k Waifus look even better with compression issues fixed for all Waifus.
[*] [b]DLC Handling/ Ram Usage Update[/b] - The way DLC is handled has been re-written. DLC loading is slightly faster; but most importantly Ram usage is now around 2GB compared to the almost 4GB it used to use! After SP:WS has finished loading, Ram usage is less than 1GB! 
[*] [b]DLC Size Updates[/b] - All DLC has been updated and now all DLC files are smaller taking up less of your HDD!
[/list]

Cheers.

Kink Master Studios/Takeover Studios.
